rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Dynamic_DNS {
    meta:
        description = "Detects Cobalt Strike beaconing behavior with dynamic DNS patterns"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1071.001/"
        tlp = "amber"
        date = "2026-04-11"

        $beacon_post = "POST /control.php" wide ascii
        $junk_param = "&m=" wide ascii
    condition:
        any of ($beacon_*) and filesize < 500KB
}
